blocks.html:
This method adds a new fulfillment set to a stock location. It sends a request to the
[Add Fulfillment Set to Stock Location](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#stock-locations\_poststocklocationsidfulfillmentsets)
API route.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the stock location to add the fulfillment set to.

types.name: body
types.description: The details of the fulfillment set to add.

children.name: name
children.description: The name of the fulfillment set.

children.name: type
children.description: The type of the fulfillment set.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.
